birth.condition: first registered resident accepted after manifest, identity and lifecycle validation

dashboard.failureRule: failure remains visible and cannot be laundered by a downstream healthy chip
dashboard.plannedRendering: roadmap metadata only; no status color/value

states.DEGRADED: resident running with validated coverage, integrity, scarcity, strain, saturation or protected impairment
states.LIVE: explicitly promoted authoritative mode plus healthy lifecycle
states.NEUTRAL: accepted resident; zero biological output permission
states.OFFLINE: previously activated core lacks accepted resident/liveness and is not recovering
states.QUARANTINED: validated isolation or authority conflict; highest precedence
